label: IgA nephropathy / forum discussion, 2026 Q2 ingest
notes: Source: CSV-as-JSON of a 17-thread r/IgANephropathy excerpt; columns Thread, Conversation, Comment, Username, Anonymized Username, Timestamp, Context, Text.

Context column in the source held thread titles (not per-user role flair). Stripped at parse time so the importer doesn't try to map it; role is assigned downstream via heuristic inference into author_attrs.json.
Long announcement-style posts are sentence-split at ingest (>=400 chars AND >=4 sentences). Short replies stay as one fragment per row.
Per the corpus-naming rule, the slug omits the literal platform name ("reddit"); platform is still captured in source_ref.platform.
